families.code: Writing, reviewing or transforming source code.
families.structured: Producing structured output: labels, fields, records.
families.reasoning: Multi-step reasoning, math, planning and agent steps.

data.description: Write new source code, queries or scripts from a specification.
Review, critique, lint or refactor existing source code.
Condense a longer text into a shorter one, preserving key points.
Translate text from one natural language into another.
Assign one label from a fixed set of labels.
Pull structured fields or records out of unstructured input.
Answer a question, optionally grounded in supplied context.
Multi-step logical reasoning or analysis without a specific domain.
Break a goal into an ordered plan of steps.
An agent step that selects and calls tools or functions.
Find, locate or survey existing code: search a codebase, trace usages, map its structure.
Diagnose and fix a defect: failing tests, errors, crashes, flaky behaviour.
Write or update documentation: READMEs, docstrings, changelogs, release notes.
